title: Phase 1 Multi-Cloud GenAI Threat Model
summary: Protect confidential enterprise knowledge across Azure, AWS and GCP through identity, application, workload, data and operational controls. A private network is one vault control; valid identities and authorized releases still require verification.
assumptions: Illustrative design; no live resources were inspected. All controls are proposed and scores require review.
Azure hosts an employee-facing containerized RAG assistant and managed model endpoint; AWS stores approved source documents; GCP handles ingestion and vector search.
Enterprise identity provider authenticates employees. Separate workload identities query, ingest and deploy.
Confidential data crosses cloud boundaries only after data-owner approval. Exact services, regions, retention and contracts remain open.

No autonomous action tools; model training and provider physical controls are out of scope. Customer owns application authorization, IAM and resource configuration; provider responsibilities vary by selected service.

vault_mapping.cloud: Segmentation, private access and egress controls
MFA, explicit workload federation and least privilege
Independent approval for high-risk IAM and releases
Protected document and administrative access records
Containment runbooks and verified clean backups

boundaries.description: Browser to identity and application; authenticate user and authorize each document.
Application to model; untrusted context cannot grant permissions.
Azure/GCP to AWS; bind federation claims and read-only resource permissions.
Azure to GCP index; server derives user entitlements and filters retrieval.
Contributor to production; independent review and scoped release authority.
Production to evidence/recovery; protect logs and backups independently.

flows.authorization: Validate issuer audience expiry; authorize user
Exact federated workload and scoped object access
Dedicated index write identity; approved document version
Dedicated query identity; server enforces document ACL
Scoped inference permission; approved data handling

flows.data: Object access events and recovery copies

threats.weakness: Standing privilege and weak change approval
threats.impact: Stolen admin session plus standing privilege changes cross-cloud trust; broad data access. A4, TB1/3.

controls.prevent: Phishing-resistant MFA; time-bound admin; dual approval for trust edits
controls.detect: Alert on privilege activation and trust change followed by unusual reads
controls.respond: Disable identity; apply resource deny; remove trust; assess issued sessions

threats.validation: Unapproved trust edit rejected; exercise session containment

threats.weakness: Server trusts caller document IDs or ACL labels
threats.impact: API trusts document IDs or caller ACL labels; employee retrieves another group's confidential chunks. A1-3, F3/5.

controls.prevent: Server-side document authorization before retrieval, source fetch and citations; isolate caches
controls.detect: Alert on successful unauthorized canary retrieval and repeated denials
controls.respond: Disable affected retrieval route; invalidate caches
controls.recover: Repair ACL propagation and rebuild affected index

threats.validation: Two-user cross-group tests return zero unauthorized chunks, citations or cached answers

threats.weakness: Wildcard subjects/audiences and excess resource permission
threats.impact: Federation accepts broad subject/audience; compromised workload acquires unintended AWS/GCP permissions. A1/2/4, TB3/4.

controls.prevent: Exact issuer subject audience and environment bindings; separate query/ingestion identities
controls.detect: Unexpected role exchange or resource access
controls.respond: Remove trust and deny principal at resources
controls.recover: Rebuild scoped trust using reviewed IaC

threats.validation: Wrong issuer subject audience and environment all fail; valid identity has only required permissions

threats.weakness: Untrusted text treated as instructions or excessive context sent
threats.impact: Malicious retrieved text influences model; excessive context or unsafe rendering leaks data or misleads users. A2/3, TB2.

controls.prevent: Separate instructions from content; minimize context; no model-controlled authorization; escape output
controls.detect: Track injection evaluation failures and anomalous citations
controls.recover: Restore approved prompt and trusted index

threats.validation: Adversarial documents cannot expand access or trigger actions; evaluate answer reliability separately

threats.weakness: Runner or dependency can publish unapproved privileged image
threats.impact: Compromised dependency or runner publishes privileged image; runtime steals tokens and reads documents. A4/5, TB5.

controls.prevent: Isolated builds; dependency checks; provenance/digest verification; independent release approval
controls.detect: Artifact drift and unusual runtime processes
controls.respond: Freeze releases; isolate workloads; deny identity
controls.recover: Rebuild clean artifact and redeploy reviewed version

threats.validation: Unapproved digest and unreviewed release rejected; record approval and provenance

threats.weakness: SSRF or runtime compromise plus excessive workload privilege
threats.impact: SSRF or runtime compromise reaches credentials; overbroad workload role enables secret/data reads. A1/4, TB2/3.

controls.prevent: SSRF input/egress checks; minimal identity grants; non-root workload; no unnecessary secrets
controls.respond: Isolate runtime; deny identity; rotate exposed secrets

threats.validation: Bounded SSRF tests and permission checks prove non-required stores/secrets inaccessible

threats.weakness: Public access permissive key grants or verbose prompt logs
threats.impact: Public store, permissive key policy or verbose prompt logs expose confidential data. A1-4, TB3/6.

controls.prevent: Block public access; scope decrypt grants; encrypt; redact logs
controls.detect: Exposure drift and unusual object/decrypt reads
controls.respond: Restrict resource; rotate exposed secrets; assess disclosure

threats.validation: Verify anonymous access denied and test sensitive markers absent from logs

threats.weakness: Unreviewed source writes or ACL metadata tampering
threats.impact: Curator/connector can overwrite approved source and ACL metadata; poisoned knowledge corrupts answers. A1-3, F4.

controls.prevent: Read-only ingestion; approved source versions; provenance checks
controls.detect: Unexpected source version/hash or ACL drift

threats.validation: Tampered source and ACL metadata quarantined; trusted reindex passes authorization tests

threats.impact: Privileged actor disables audit or erases records; misuse cannot be attributed. A6, TB6.

controls.prevent: Independent restricted log destination and retention protections
controls.detect: Required log stream absent for 10 minutes or unapproved retention change
controls.respond: Preserve independent evidence; restrict destructive access
controls.recover: Restore collector and approved logging configuration

threats.validation: Safe log-disable event reaches SOC within target and production admin cannot erase archive

threats.weakness: No user quotas concurrency limits or timeouts
threats.impact: User floods costly requests or dependency fails; no quotas/fallback produces outage and cost spike. A3, F2/5/6.

controls.prevent: Per-user quotas; request/token limits; circuit breakers
controls.detect: Volume/spend twice baseline for 10 minutes; error/latency alert
controls.respond: Throttle requests; disable generation with safe unavailable response
controls.recover: Restore capacity and verify dependency health

threats.validation: Bounded load and dependency-failure test verifies caps and safe failures

threats.weakness: Same principal can delete production and every backup
threats.impact: Attacker deletes source/index and backups using same authority; recovery fails. A1/2/6, TB6.

controls.prevent: Separate backup authority; retained versions; reviewed deletion policy
controls.detect: Backup retention changes and mass deletion
controls.respond: Freeze destructive identities; preserve surviving copies
controls.recover: Restore trusted source and ACLs into clean environment and reindex

threats.validation: Restore drill measures RTO 4h and RPO 24h targets; compromised production identity cannot delete all copies

attack_paths.name: Stolen identity crosses clouds
attack_paths.breakpoints: Time-bound privilege, independent trust approval, scoped object access and correlated data-read alerts.

attack_paths.name: Private retrieval leaks documents
attack_paths.breakpoints: Server-side document ACLs before context assembly; per-user cache isolation and canary tests.

attack_paths.name: Compromised release steals data
steps: Read data and suppress local logs
attack_paths.breakpoints: Verified release digest, independent approval, narrow workload role and independent logs.

attack_paths.name: Poisoned recovery
attack_paths.breakpoints: Independent source approval, protected versions and tested clean reindex.
